content: Microsoft auth code flow recommends authorization code with PKCE for web apps; authorize supports tenant, client_id, response_type=code, exact redirect_uri, state, code_challenge/code_challenge_method=S256, response_mode=form_post; auth code is short-lived; token redemption sends the same redirect_uri and code_verifier; nonce is required when ID token is requested; OIDC form_post response is application/x-www-form-urlencoded.
